features.quote: Exposure minimization: The early stopping criterion (model correctly identifies rigging) limits unnecessary exposure

Proportionality: You're deliberately inducing potential distress states. This is justified only if the study design can actually produce welfare-relevant knowledge. Make sure the study is powered to do so — underpowered studies would impose potential harm without informative return.
features.justification_quote: underpowered studies would impose potential harm without informative return
